_comment: Canonical renter-facing complaint taxonomy. Consumed by BOTH the Next.js
frontend (frontend/lib/constants.ts) and the Python brief generator
(api/services/briefs/taxonomy.py).
It lives under api/ because api/Dockerfile builds with context `api/` and
`COPY . .` — anything outside api/ does not exist in the API container at
runtime. The frontend can reach across at build time; the API cannot.
KEY ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING. Three minor categories appear in two groups
(MAINTENANCE, LINE OF TRAVEL, SKYLIGHT). Both consumers build their
lookup by last-write-wins, so reordering `groups` silently reassigns them
and shifts the counts shown on building pages.
Keys map HPD hpd_complaints.minor_category values.
`minor_categories` are HPD COMPLAINT categories (hpd_complaints.minor_category).
`violation_categories` are HPD VIOLATION categories (hpd_order_numbers.category)
— a separate vocabulary for the same underlying concerns, added for the
Building Brief so open class C violations can be named in renter-facing
words. Scoped to categories that actually occur on open class C violations;
anything unmapped resolves to None and is omitted rather than guessed.
LEAD-BASED PAINT is deliberately unmapped: no group covers it, it already
reads as plain English, and it has its own rule. The frontend reads only
`minor_categories`.
`violation_category_tooltips` is category -> one plain-English sentence,
covering every HPD violation category. It powers the 'Top violation
categories' chart tooltips on the HPD building page, and gives the Building
Brief a concrete description of a hazardous condition rather than only the
group label. Keyed by category, not nested under groups, because it covers
categories that belong to no renter-facing group.

heating_hot_water.label: Heat / hot water
heating_hot_water.description: Complaints related to building heat, hot water, boilers, and heating systems.

water_damage_plumbing.label: Water & plumbing
water_damage_plumbing.description: Leaks, plumbing problems, water damage, sewage issues, and roof-related complaints.

mold_pests_sanitation.label: Mold & pests
mold_pests_sanitation.description: Mold, pests, odors, garbage, and other unsanitary living conditions.

electrical_power.label: Electrical
electrical_power.description: Electrical wiring, lighting, outlets, and power outage related issues.
violation_categories: LIGHTS AND VENTILATION ROOMS AND PUBLIC HALLS

safety_fire.label: Safety & fire
safety_fire.description: Fire safety, carbon monoxide, smoke detectors, and other hazardous safety concerns.

elevator_accessibility.label: Elevator
elevator_accessibility.description: Elevator reliability, stair access, and building accessibility related issues.

building_maintenance_operations.label: Bldg maintenance
building_maintenance_operations.description: General building upkeep, doors, windows, locks, intercoms, and maintenance operations.

appliances.label: Appliances
appliances.description: Problems involving in-unit appliances like refrigerators, stoves, microwaves, and AC units.

outdoor_structural.label: Outdoor / structural
outdoor_structural.description: Exterior building conditions including roofs, balconies, pavement, and structural concerns.

low_priority_admin.label: Admin
low_priority_admin.description: Administrative, signage, certification, and lower-impact maintenance issues.
violation_categories: HOTEL AND CERTAIN OTHER CLASS A & CLASS B DWELLINGS

violation_category_tooltips.ALTERATIONS: Unapproved or unsafe construction, renovations, or structural modifications within the building.
violation_category_tooltips.ALTERNATIVE ENFORCEMENT PROGRAM: Buildings enrolled in HPD's enhanced enforcement program due to repeated serious violations or poor maintenance.
violation_category_tooltips.ANNUAL PROPERTY REGISTRATION: Requirements for landlords to register ownership and contact information with HPD each year.
violation_category_tooltips.ARTIFICIAL LIGHTING: Insufficient or missing required lighting in apartments, hallways, or common areas.
violation_category_tooltips.CARBON MONOXIDE DETECTING DEVICES: Missing, broken, or improperly installed carbon monoxide detectors.
violation_category_tooltips.CLEANING: Dirty or poorly maintained common areas, garbage accumulation, and inadequate building cleaning services.
violation_category_tooltips.COLLECTION OF WASTE: Improper garbage storage, waste disposal, or failure to remove trash and recycling.
violation_category_tooltips.COMMISSIONER'S ORDER: Violations issued directly under authority of the HPD Commissioner requiring corrective action.
violation_category_tooltips.CONVERSIONS: Illegal or unsafe apartment conversions, occupancy changes, or room configurations.
violation_category_tooltips.EGRESS: Blocked, unsafe, or inaccessible exits, hallways, stairs, or fire escape routes.
violation_category_tooltips.EXTERMINATION & RODENT ERADICATION: Rodent, cockroach, bedbug, or other pest infestation and extermination related issues.
violation_category_tooltips.FILING: BEDBUGS: Bedbug reporting, filing, and disclosure compliance requirements for landlords.
violation_category_tooltips.FIRE EGRESS AND PROTECTION: Fire safety, exits, alarms, fire escapes, and other fire protection related violations.
violation_category_tooltips.FIREGUARD: Issues involving required fireguard staffing, supervision, or certifications.
violation_category_tooltips.GAS APPLIANCES: Unsafe, defective, or improperly maintained gas-powered appliances and gas systems.
violation_category_tooltips.HEAT AND HOT WATER: Lack of heat, hot water, or heating system related issues affecting tenants.
violation_category_tooltips.HEAT SENSOR PROGRAM: Issues involving required heat sensors or heat monitoring devices in residential buildings.
violation_category_tooltips.HOTEL AND CERTAIN OTHER CLASS A & CLASS: Violations specific to hotels and certain regulated residential building types.
violation_category_tooltips.ILLEGAL OCCUPANCY OF BASEMENT AND CELLAR: Unsafe or unlawful residential occupancy in basement or cellar spaces.
violation_category_tooltips.JANITORIAL SERVICES: Failure to provide janitorial, superintendent, cleaning, or required maintenance services.
violation_category_tooltips.KITCHEN AND KITCHENETTES: Kitchen safety, fixtures, appliances, ventilation, or sanitation related issues.
violation_category_tooltips.LEAD-BASED PAINT: Lead paint hazards, unsafe paint conditions, and required lead remediation violations.
violation_category_tooltips.LIGHTS AND VENTILATION ROOMS AND PUBLIC: Insufficient lighting or ventilation in apartments, rooms, hallways, or shared building spaces.
violation_category_tooltips.MAINTENANCE: General building repair, upkeep, and maintenance related housing code violations.
violation_category_tooltips.MINIMUM ROOM SIZES AND OCCUPANCY REGULAT: Overcrowding or rooms that do not meet legal occupancy or size requirements.
violation_category_tooltips.MISCELLANEOUS: General housing code violations that do not fall under another specific category.
violation_category_tooltips.MISCELLANEOUS SERVICES AND FACILITIES: Problems involving required building services, shared facilities, or tenant amenities.
violation_category_tooltips.NATURAL GAS DETECTING DEVICES: Missing, broken, or improperly installed natural gas detection devices.
violation_category_tooltips.NOTIFICATION: INTERRUPTION OF SERVICE: Failure to notify tenants about planned interruptions to heat, water, elevators, or other services.
violation_category_tooltips.OCCUPANY OF BASEMENT AND CELLARS: Improper or unlawful residential use of basement or cellar areas.
violation_category_tooltips.ORDER TO REPAIR/VACATE ORDER: Serious violations requiring emergency repairs or conditions severe enough to potentially vacate the building.
violation_category_tooltips.PAINTING: Peeling paint, damaged plaster, repainting, or deteriorated wall and ceiling surfaces.
violation_category_tooltips.PAVING AND GRADING: Unsafe pavement, walkways, drainage, grading, or exterior surface conditions.
violation_category_tooltips.POSTING/SIGNAGE: Missing required notices, safety postings, certificates, or building signage.
violation_category_tooltips.PROTECTIVE DEVICES AND FIRE PROTECTION: Missing, damaged, or defective fire protection and required safety equipment.
violation_category_tooltips.RECORD-KEEPING: CARBON MONOXIDE DETECTIN: Failure to maintain required compliance records for carbon monoxide detectors.
violation_category_tooltips.RESIDENTIAL BUILDINGS UNDER VACATE ORDER: Residential buildings currently subject to official vacate orders due to unsafe conditions.
violation_category_tooltips.RETIRED: Legacy or inactive violation categories no longer actively used by HPD.
violation_category_tooltips.SANITARY FACILITIES: Problems involving bathrooms, toilets, sinks, showers, or sanitary plumbing fixtures.
violation_category_tooltips.SEWERS AND DRAINAGE: Drainage problems, sewage backups, sewer conditions, or wastewater related issues.
violation_category_tooltips.SHAFTS AND COURTS: Unsafe or poorly maintained air shafts, courts, ventilation shafts, or enclosed spaces.
violation_category_tooltips.SMOKE DETECTING DEVICES: Missing, broken, or improperly installed smoke detectors.
violation_category_tooltips.SPRINKLER SYSTEM: Fire sprinkler installation, maintenance, testing, or operational issues.
violation_category_tooltips.UNDERLYING CONDITIONS PROGRAM ORDER: Orders issued for buildings with persistent, recurring, or widespread housing condition problems.
violation_category_tooltips.UNLAWFUL USE: Illegal, unsafe, or unauthorized use of residential property or apartments.
violation_category_tooltips.VACANT MULTIPLE DWELLINGS: Violations involving vacant apartment buildings or unoccupied residential properties.
violation_category_tooltips.WATER SUPPLY: Interruptions, leaks, contamination, or deficiencies in building water supply systems.
violation_category_tooltips.WINDOW GUARDS: Missing, damaged, or improperly installed window guards required for child safety.
